resources.string: That time or a newer one must be seen, ideally from another device or the web. Seeing the file is not enough: it has existed since it was created, and on this phone that app may show one that has not uploaded yet.
Check noted. It records what was seen: %1$s does not verify the backup.
%1$s could not be opened from here. Open that app by hand, look for %2$s and check its time.
If it does not appear with that time
Open %1$s with internet and check that it is signed in and has free space.
Tap Back up now, wait a while and check the time again.
If the time still does not change, export a backup today and choose a service with WebDAV. Until then, anything new is only on this phone.
